narr: The combination of westerly flow aloft, moderate to strong instability and a dryline resulted in scattered severe thunderstorms across portions of west central Texas. A few the storms were supercell thunderstorms, which merged into a line of thunderstorms while moving east across the area. The severe storms produced large hail and isolated damaging winds.
ev: There was 2 to 3 inches of water in 3 homes on the southeast side of Merkel. Also, roads were flooded.
